k01-woman-waiter.observed_description: A smiling woman with curly red hair in a white shirt and a long black apron stands on a cafe terrace carrying a tray with two cups of coffee. One person.
k01-woman-waiter.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

k02-man-artist.observed_description: A white-haired man with round glasses in a paint-stained shirt sits at an easel by a window and paints a bowl of fruit with a brush, a palette of paints on his knee. One person.
k02-man-artist.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.
